title: Claude Fable 5.2 solves two open problems in the physics of black holes
headline: Anthropic reports AI agents solved two open problems in theoretical physics
summary: Anthropic researchers used Claude Fable 5.2 to solve two long-standing problems in theoretical physics concerning black holes and quantum gravity. The AI agents operated as a research group, independently calculating complex mathematical proofs and verifying results against known literature. These findings were subsequently verified using Lean, a computerized proof checker.
why_it_matters: The use of autonomous AI agents to perform complex, verifiable scientific research demonstrates an emerging capability for AI to contribute to rigorous, high-stakes technical assurance and mathematical proof-checking.

quotes.text: Claude did it by running a small research group of copies of itself, in which it worked out almost every piece of the calculation independently and checked its math against known results.
In September, the results were formally verified in Lean, a computerized proof checker. Claude then wrote the paper with minimal guidance, and a physicist checked every main result.

classification.significance_reason: Demonstrates advanced autonomous reasoning and formal verification capabilities in AI, relevant to the future of automated assurance and scientific research.
